title: Decision ledger entry
description: One line of decisions/ledger.jsonl: a decision a person took, how sure they were, how and when it will be checked, and what happened. Producer: decision_maker.core.decision_commitment.Commitment.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601, UTC, when the decision was recorded

confidence.description: Stated probability that it works; what calibration scores

success_metric.description: Something observable in the world, never a model statistic

deadline.description: Legacy field, empty in new entries; review_date replaces it

was_successful.description: Meaningful only when outcome_recorded is true
